request.subject: TERRAIN:FOREST

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Class: one raised terrain feature (trees or rocks) drawn as a free-standing cut-out cluster, calmer and less saturated than units, thick single-colour black outline, simple shapes, no face and no eyes. It stands on the empty transparent background: nothing is drawn under it, no ground, no grass, no soil, no slab, no tile and no platform; it is composited onto its ground tile afterwards.
layers.negative: ground plate, platform, grass square, soil patch, slab, isometric block, background, buildings, characters, people, red

layers.text: Subject: a dense clump of three or four chunky round-crowned trees and one pine packed tightly together, muted deep green and olive leaves in big simple blobs, short dark grey-brown trunks, the clump as wide as the image; the tree trunks are the lowest thing in the image, with no ground, no grass patch, no soil and no shadow under them.
This clump is three round-crowned trees with one pine standing at the left.
